pawnDisposal.title: Disposal accounting
pawnDisposal.rule: Verified proceeds pay documented costs agreed by you, then principal, then interest. Surplus belongs to you; a shortfall remains debt. Interest stops after principal and interest are fully paid. Original signed terms stay in your history.
pawnDisposal.interestStopped: Interest stopped after full settlement on {date}.
pawnDisposal.reconciliationRequired: The source sale or buyer claim changed. Financial actions are paused until a revised statement is reviewed and signed. No debt has been waived.
pawnDisposal.failed: The action could not be completed. Review the current statement and try again.
pawnDisposal.noSales: No completed, fully collected and undisputed source sale is available yet.
pawnDisposal.amendmentTemplate: Verified net merchandise proceeds exclude shipping and tax. The order discount is allocated proportionally to original merchandise values, with whole-VND remainders assigned by remainder size and then line ID. The documented costs listed in this statement require your explicit agreement. Proceeds pay these costs first, then principal, then simple accrued interest under the original signed rate, day-count and cap. Any surplus is owed to you; a shortfall remains outstanding debt. Interest stops only when principal and interest are fully paid. Disposal alone does not forgive debt or stop interest. Any proceeds correction requires another signed amendment; a later refund does not retroactively restart interest that already stopped after full settlement. Both parties must sign this current amendment before proceeds are applied.
pawnDisposal.offerNote: Use the actual collected source sale and original expense records. A correction retains previously accepted costs. The customer must agree and both parties must sign; an estimate crossing an interest day boundary needs renewed consent.
pawnDisposal.termsAccepted: I accept this exact disposal allocation, outstanding debt, interest-stop and surplus agreement.
pawnDisposal.costsAccepted: I reviewed and accept the specific documented costs and calculated amounts above.
pawnDisposal.signaturesVerified: I verified both signatures on the current accepted amendment and original supporting documents.
pawnDisposal.moneyVerified: I verified this completed bank transaction.
pawnDisposal.receivingAccountVerified: I verified the transfer reached the customer-approved receiving account shown above.
